name: The Orchid Show 2026: Christian Sampson
blurb: Selby Gardens' signature fall exhibition fills its bayfront conservatory with orchid installations by artist Christian Sampson. Admission is $28 for adults, $12 for ages 5–17, and free for members and kids 4 and under.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Sarasota Magazine

name: Best of The Bay Music Fest
address: 1055 Boulevard of the Arts, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: An afternoon of live music on the bayfront lawn at The Bay, Sarasota's new waterfront park, with food trucks and family activities. Free to attend; bring a blanket and stay for sunset over Sarasota Bay.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
address: Lemon Ave & Main St, Sarasota, FL 34236
blurb: Florida's iconic downtown market with local produce, flowers, baked goods and prepared foods. Free to browse, and a classic Saturday-morning stroll through downtown Sarasota.

name: Sarasota's 22nd Hispanic Fall Festival
blurb: A lively celebration of Hispanic culture with live music, dancing, and food from across Latin America. Admission is free; food, drinks and raffle tickets are sold separately.
